text:
Ivy (Marketing): Heads up 1 ClearStack wants a lightweight co-marketing push on their marketplace. Idea: 1) short benchmarks blog, 2) 30-min joint webinar, 3) gated demo on our site. Target: May 8 1 week. Thoughts? :calendar:
Noah (Partnerships): They want a featured slot in their marketplace rollout and co-branded listing copy. Assets due Apr 20. Webinar ok for May 9.
Zara (Growth): For routing: partner=clearstack in form, utm_source=clearstack_market. Route to queue=partner_mkt and tag partner_clearstack. Need SF campaign param.
Ben (Sales): Add SF fields: Partner_Ref (text) and Lead_Intent (picklist). Also capture "monthly_token_estimate" as ranges.
Kai (Content): I'll draft benchmark outline: test chat + short completions, p50/p95, and cost-per-1k token at 3 batching configs. Need ENG traces and sample prompts by Apr 10.
Ivy (Marketing): Action: Noah get partner assets by Apr 20; Kai draft by Apr 12; Zara provide webhook spec by Apr 8; Ben define SF fields by Apr 9.
Zara (Growth): Routing snippet (pseudo):
POST /hooks/partner
body: {email, name, partner, utm_source, answers}
if partner=="clearstack" -> tag=partner_clearstack; queue=partner_mkt; campaign=clearstack_launch
Ben (Sales): Can we add a short qualifier: "Use case" (Product/PoC/Internal)? Helps prioritization.
Noah (Partnerships): Partner will provide a short customer quote for the webinar. I'll confirm speaker by Apr 7.
calendar-bot: Event created: "ClearStack co-marketing kickoff" Apr 4 11:00 AM PT 0 attendees: Ivy, Noah, Zara, Ben, Kai.
Ivy (Marketing): Cool. I'll compile the launch checklist and drop in the kickoff doc. Ping here for approvals. :thumbsup:
